summary: Bootstrap now creates a 'release' branch from main when absent. PR documentation check now enforces a fragment in .agentic/releases/unreleased/<slug>.json for Feature PRs (fragment-first).
migration_impact: gh plate bootstrap --apply now creates the 'release' branch if it does not exist. The pr-documentation-check.yml now requires .agentic/releases/unreleased/<slug>.json instead of any .agentic/releases/ file.
migration_guidance: 1. Run `gh plate bootstrap --apply` in your repo to create the 'release' branch from main.
2. Protect the 'release' branch: enable 'Require a pull request before merging', no direct push.
3. Feature PRs must now include a fragment at .agentic/releases/unreleased/<slug>.json — legacy flat .agentic/releases/vX.Y.Z.json files are still accepted but deprecated.
4. Release ceremony: git checkout release && git reset --hard <tag> && git push --force-with-lease
agent_notes: Always author a fragment in .agentic/releases/unreleased/ before opening a Feature PR. Run gh plate bootstrap --apply once per new repo to set up the release branch.
